programme.desc: Three Turkeys: Phil is cooking Thanksgiving dinner this year with Luke as his sous chef. But Claire has no confidence in them and prepares a secret turkey of her own as backup.

programme.title: Modern Family

programme.desc: Haley's 21st Birthday: The family take Haley to a bar to celebrate her 21st birthday. Can Claire convince Haley to see her as a friend, rather than as her uptight mum?

programme.title: The Simpsons

programme.desc: The Way We Weren't: Homer admits that Marge wasn't his first kiss. A flashback to Homer's youth reveals all about his first romantic clinch - and the reason they lost touch.

programme.title: Hollyoaks
